_schema_note: Ruleset Store DB record — record_type: ruleset_tier_config. This is the complete tier selection rule set evaluated top-down by the Clinical Signal Engine (offline) and exposed via MCP Tool get_program_ruleset(patient_token) at query time. First matching rule wins.
_version_note: Draft v2026.03.1-draft — for clinical expert verification. Set status to 'active' only after Medical Acceptance Test (MAT) confirms ≥ 95% accuracy on 100 blind cases (TOR §6.2).
_framework_reference: rule-synthesis-framework.md — all signal_ids trace to signal-store-contract.md Field Dictionary; all clinical claims trace to clinical-guidelines-reference.md
_option_a_symptom_signals: Symptom-derived signals (symptom_palpitations, symptom_chronic_back_pain, symptom_unexplained_weight_loss, symptom_chest_pain, symptom_dyspnea_on_exertion) are treated as first-class signal IDs per Option A resolution. They are populated by the Clinical Signal Engine from the symptom_tags[] array in get_clinical_signals. These must be added to the signal-store-contract.md Field Dictionary before production deployment.
_expert_review_instructions: Please verify: (1) tier boundary signals and thresholds in each rule; (2) which signals belong in Premium vs Advanced pools; (3) whether min_count values are clinically appropriate; (4) whether any signals are missing from or incorrectly placed in a pool. Somchai W. (sample_patient_checkup.json) fires 8 of 12 signals in PREMIUM_MULTI_SIGNAL — see _expert_review_note on that rule.
change_summary: Initial ruleset draft — synthesized from clinical-guidelines-reference.md v1.0 and navavej-checkup-package-discovery.md v1.0. Pending MAT validation.

tier_selection_rules._clinical_rationale: A single high-severity condition that places the patient in active multi-organ disease or imminent serious-outcome territory. Any one is sufficient to warrant the Diamond (Premium) program.
tier_selection_rules._expert_review_note: Please confirm: are these the correct conditions for mandatory Premium escalation? Should any be Advanced instead?

conditions.description: CKD rapid progression — eGFR annual decline > 5 mL/min/1.73m². KDIGO 2022: urgent nephrology referral; comprehensive evaluation warranted beyond Advanced.
ASCVD 10-year risk ≥ 20%. ACC/AHA 2013/2018: high-intensity statin mandatory + comprehensive cardiovascular workup beyond standard Enhanced screening.
Hypertensive crisis — SBP > 180 OR DBP > 120. ACC/AHA 2017: emergency evaluation; EST and contrast procedures contraindicated. Cannot proceed with routine checkup without specialist clearance.

Confirmed DM (HbA1c ≥ 6.5%) with active organ complication screening gap — at least one of: retinopathy, nephropathy, neuropathy, or cardiac screening overdue. ADA 2024: multi-organ surveillance program required.

ALT > 3× ULN (significant hepatocellular injury) combined with liver disease risk indicator (NAFLD, alcohol, or high TG). AASLD 2023: comprehensive hepatic evaluation required — beyond basic LFT add-on.

tier_selection_rules.guideline_basis: TOR §3.2: Risk Level High → Premium/Personalized Package

admin_configurable._note: No admin-configurable fields. Any change to conditions requires clinical review and code release.

tier_selection_rules._clinical_rationale: Convergence of multiple independent moderate-severity risk signals across organ systems. Even without a single dominant condition, the cumulative burden exceeds what an Advanced (Platinum) package with add-ons can adequately address.
tier_selection_rules._expert_review_note: CRITICAL CALIBRATION ITEM. The sample patient Somchai W. (sample_patient_checkup.json) fires 8 of 12 signals in this pool: prediabetes_confirmed, htn_active, dyslipidemia_active, ascvd_risk_intermediate, family_hx_premature_cad, at_risk_alcohol_use, lung_ct_threshold_met, uric_acid_hyperuricemia. With min_count: 5, Somchai resolves to Premium. Clinical question: Is Premium (Diamond) appropriate for Somchai's profile, or should he remain Advanced (Platinum)? If Somchai should be Advanced, either (a) raise min_count to 9, or (b) remove some signals from the pool (e.g., uric_acid_hyperuricemia, at_risk_alcohol_use) to reduce his match count below the threshold.

conditions.description: ≥ 5 of 12 moderate-severity risk signals active simultaneously — indicates multi-system disease burden requiring comprehensive Premium evaluation.

_signal_pool_rationale.bmi_obese_asian: Metabolic — Asian-adjusted obese (BMI ≥ 27.5); high NCD risk
_signal_pool_rationale.family_hx_premature_cad: Genetic — first-degree premature CAD; ACC/AHA risk enhancer
_signal_pool_rationale.at_risk_alcohol_use: Behavioral — AUDIT-C positive; liver + metabolic risk
_signal_pool_rationale.fibroscan_indication: Hepatic — liver disease risk from BMI + ALT or alcohol + ALT
_signal_pool_rationale.lung_ct_threshold_met: Oncologic — LDCT-eligible smoker; significant cancer risk
_signal_pool_rationale.uric_acid_hyperuricemia: Metabolic — hyperuricemia; associated with metabolic syndrome

tier_selection_rules.guideline_basis: TOR §3.2: Risk Level High → Premium/Personalized Package

admin_configurable._note: Admin may adjust min_count via Admin Panel. Signal pool membership requires code release + clinical review. Final threshold must be validated by MAT.

tier_selection_rules._clinical_rationale: Any single moderate-severity signal places the patient into elevated-risk territory requiring enhanced (Platinum) screening beyond the standard annual package. Alternatively, two or more lower-severity signals co-occurring indicates sufficient cumulative risk.
tier_selection_rules._expert_review_note: Please verify: (1) Are all 7 single-signal qualifiers appropriate for Advanced? Should any be Standard instead? (2) Is min_count: 2 the right threshold for the low-moderate pool? (3) Are all 13 low-moderate pool signals correctly categorized?

conditions.description: Pre-diabetes confirmed (FBS 100–125 or HbA1c 5.7–6.4%) OR diabetes requiring confirmation (FBS ≥ 126, pending retest). ADA 2024: significantly elevated DM progression risk.
ASCVD 10-year risk 7.5–19.9% (Intermediate). ACC/AHA 2018: moderate-intensity statin consideration + enhanced cardiovascular screening.
Active hypertension comorbidity confirmed (Stage 1 or Stage 2 HTN with comorbidity tag). Requires enhanced monitoring beyond Standard package baseline.
LDCT lung cancer screening eligible — age 50–80, ≥ 20 pack-years, current smoker or quit ≤ 15 years. USPSTF 2021 Grade B: annual screening indicated.
CKD any stage confirmed. KDIGO 2022: requires structured monitoring and nephrology input beyond Standard baseline.
Obese by Asian-adjusted BMI (≥ 27.5 kg/m²). WHO Asia-Pacific 2000: significantly elevated NCD risk requiring enhanced metabolic screening.
≥ 2 of 17 low-to-moderate severity signals active simultaneously — combined risk burden warrants enhanced screening beyond Standard.

_signal_pool_rationale.bp_stage1_htn: SBP 130–139 or DBP 80–89 (ACC/AHA 2017 Stage 1); not yet active comorbidity
_signal_pool_rationale.bp_worsening: BP trend worsening over serial readings
_signal_pool_rationale.family_hx_premature_cad: First-degree premature CAD; ACC/AHA risk enhancer
_signal_pool_rationale.family_hx_early_heart_attack: Family history of early cardiovascular events
_signal_pool_rationale.office_syndrome: Prolonged sedentary desk work; MSK + metabolic risk
_signal_pool_rationale.night_shift_worker: Rotating/permanent night shift; elevated DM + HTN + sleep risk
_signal_pool_rationale.uric_acid_hyperuricemia: Uric acid above sex-specific threshold; metabolic syndrome marker
_signal_pool_rationale.symptom_fatigue: Reported fatigue; metabolic or hormonal indicator

tier_selection_rules.guideline_basis: TOR §3.2: Risk Level Moderate → Advanced Package
